training.qa_schedule: complete original QA coverage across sealed per-context event occurrences; context-balanced losses
training.curriculum: rounds 0/1: two isolated 19-context windows; rounds 2/3: 39-context recurrent streams
training.teacher_scope: Full answer-content CE and KL only; EOS excluded from eligibility
training.distillation: answer-position KL(Full || Shared), averaged over eligible training QAs
training.checkpoint: last scheduled update only; no within-training selection
training.answer_supervision: one leading ASCII space + original answer; separate true EOS CE
training.objective: context-balanced recovery content CE + eligible Full content KL + protection content hinge + first-token Selection KL anchor + separate EOS CE
training.recovery_weight: 1 + clamp(CE_Selection - CE_Full, 0, 2); mean one within noncarrier cohort
training.cohort_policy: native carrier origins plus untouched tail are protected; all other written original contexts recover
training.carrier_policy: unchanged content-only selector shared by Selection/C/D; no QA-conditioned selection

DsupV6.routing_score: 0.6*native 4096-D cosine + 0.4*learned rank-32 cosine, tau .04, column log-mean load balance .15; per-slot similarity hard mask (reject-only vs peer in-block baseline, margin .01)
DsupV6.gate: slotwise hidden z-score + 3 domain-agnostic geometry features (top1 affinity, top-k sharpness, in-block redundancy); zero-initialized; one logit per layer group (8 groups)
DsupV6.delta_bound: one-sided soft RMS bound (delta scaled to carrier RMS only when its own RMS exceeds carrier RMS); no forced unit-RMS normalisation; global 5% RMS cap unchanged

DnativeV6.routing_score: 0.6*native 4096-D cosine + 0.4*learned rank-32 cosine, tau .04, column log-mean load balance .15; per-slot similarity hard mask (reject-only vs peer in-block baseline, margin .01)
DnativeV6.gate: slotwise hidden z-score + 3 domain-agnostic geometry features (top1 affinity, top-k sharpness, in-block redundancy); zero-initialized; one logit per layer group (8 groups)
DnativeV6.native_path: top-2 sharpened full-width source average minus carrier, routed-confidence scaled; one zero-initialized signed gain per layer group; combined residual one-sided soft RMS bound
DnativeV6.delta_bound: one-sided soft RMS bound on the adapted+native combined delta; global 5% RMS cap unchanged

protocol.compression_timing: before append; isolated pre/post queries before the next write

objective: context-balanced recovery content CE + eligible Full content KL + protection content hinge + first-token Selection KL anchor + separate EOS CE

dataset.scope: original SQuAD train/dev and official indices; NQ transfer reuses separately pinned processed release
dataset.verification: pinned commit resolved; byte sizes; Git blob SHA1 or LFS SHA256; local SHA256

split_audit.eligibility: E1 and training: Context-prefixed original text fits 16..512 tokens, no reader-correctness filtering
split_audit.isolation: article and exact context disjoint across train/development/formal

resources.claim: active-slot budget reduction; physical memory allocation is unchanged
